method: manual source review via the live EURES public JSON API (https://europa.eu/eures/api/jv-searchengine/public/jv/id/{source_id}): each posting fetched live, stored title compared against the live title, and the live body read for role confirmation before translation. Not model output. The batch22-held French posting (uid 00cfb0e9af186fce) remains held (no live posting) and was skipped ahead of this batch. No candidate in this batch carried a legacy partial-AR marker, so the reviewed-overwrite path (4e0c799) was not exercised here.
